Under Utah’s plan, only non-state government entities can qualify for subsidies, meaning state hospitals and private nursing facilities cannot participate. According to the audit, the majority of the 75 Upper Payment Limit licenses issued by the state are held by three entities: Beaver Valley Hospital holds 44, Gunnison Valley Hospital holds 15 and Kane County Hospital holds five.
